
LIST-SCENARIO-TAGS
List all tags on a specific scenario

USAGE
  fspec list-scenario-tags <file> <scenario> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <file> (required)
    Feature file path
  <scenario> (required)
    Scenario name

OPTIONS
  --show-categories
    Show tag categories from registry (spec/tags.json)

EXAMPLES
  1. List scenario tags
  $ fspec list-scenario-tags spec/features/login.feature "Login with invalid password"
  @edge-case
@smoke

  2. List tags with categories
  $ fspec list-scenario-tags spec/features/login.feature "Valid user login" --show-categories
  @WORK-UNIT-001 (Work Unit Tags)
@smoke (Test Type Tags)

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec add-tag-to-scenario
  fspec list-feature-tags
